Critically, N=48 means BLOCK_N=64 wastes 25% of every N-tile (only 1 tile in the N dimension, grid_n=1). Smaller tiles allow more blocks/SM, increasing warp count from ~20 to ~40-64, which better hides the FMA and memory latencies. Adding @triton.autotune lets the runtime select the best tile configuration for this specific M=204800, N=48, K=512 shape on H200.
